meta.description: Thanksgiving week (2026-11-23 to 2026-11-29) replaying the scraped 2026-10-26 cycle week. Mon-Wed run at reduced demand; Thu-Sat three halls close and Crossroads runs light. Closures are known to the forecast; the demand drop is not.

co2e_lb_per_lb.basis: menu_items.csv Eatec carbon_kg_co2 per serving / serving weight, 7618 rows (kg->lb)

blended_usd_per_lb_reference.basis: REFERENCE ONLY (superseded by data/raw/prices/ingredient_prices.csv). Blended proxy: uc_numbers food_cost_avoided (USD/yr) / hall_volume pre_consumer_waste_reduction (tons/yr x 2000), same StopWaste Cal Dining case study (c. 2012-13 dollars). Not an ingredient price.

warnings: shelf_life: 1/119 ingredients not covered by the reference table; using PLACEHOLDER category rows from generator/fallback/shelf_life.csv
yields: 55/119 ingredients not covered by reference yields/loss_rates; using PLACEHOLDER category rows from generator/fallback/yields.csv
loss_rates: 17/119 ingredients have no ERS series; using DEFAULT category-median retail_loss_pct (informational only)

reference_notes.loss_rates.csv: USDA ERS LAFA loss rates are national retail/household assumptions; used only as a household-level proxy for the inedible (trim) share of fresh produce lacking an FBG yield. Not an institutional kitchen rate.
reference_notes.shelf_life.csv: FSIS FoodKeeper consumer storage guidance (midpoint of low-high); conservative for commercial cold chain.
reference_notes.yields.csv: USDA Food Buying Guide served/as-purchased yields, applied once (recipe qty is cooked edible weight).
